description: GET /domains/records/{recordId} declares only the recordId path parameter, but like every other DNS operation it is scoped by the teamId and slug query parameters; without them a record on a team-owned domain cannot be read. Vercel's Terraform provider passes `?teamId=` on this endpoint (https://github.com/vercel/terraform-provider-vercel/blob/152fffc2d661ac6b1583496635804d5107b45037/client/dns_record.go, GetDNSRecord).
